Election later contested successfully by Rollin C. Mallary.{{efn | name="Vermont contest" |Initial returns showed [[Rollin Carolas Mallary|Rollin C. Mallary]] in 8th place with 6,879 votes and [[Orsamus Cook Merrill]] in 6th place with 6,955 votes, but after challenging the results, the [[United States House Committee on Elections|House Committee on Elections]] declared Mallary the winner of the last seat with 6,961 votes, a 6-vote lead over Merrill.{{citation needed | date=February 2015}} Mallary was seated January 13, 1820.}}
